articles.headline: Dana Altman retires as Oregon's winningest men's basketball coach
articles.description: Dana Altman, the winningest coach in Oregon men's basketball history with 382 victories and nine NCAA tournament berths, has retired after 16 seasons.

images.name: 261007 Altman [1296x729]
images.caption: Dana Altman, who retired Wednesday, was 792-425 (.651) in 37 seasons as a Division I head coach, the 15th-most wins in NCAA history and fifth highest among active coaches. His 382 wins at Oregon are the most in the program's history.
